# Project Skills — Index for AI Agents

Use this file to discover which skill to load. Each skill lives in a directory of the same name under skills/ and contains SKILL.md.

## Project Skills

product-ui-design
  产品 UI 设计规范：色彩体系（Design Token）、字体排版、组件设计、响应式布局、动效规范、页面设计参考。当用户需要设计页面布局、编写 UI 组件、调整视觉样式、创建新页面或优化用户体验时调用。
  Triggers: UI设计, 页面布局, 组件样式, 色彩, 排版, 响应式, Design Token, badge, 卡片, 图标.

nuxt-senior-engineer
  Nuxt 4 高级前端工程师：项目架构、数据获取模式（SSR/BFF/Mock）、状态管理（Pinia）、组件开发规范、样式方案、性能优化、类型安全、错误处理。当用户需要实现复杂功能、重构代码、优化性能或进行架构决策时调用。
  Triggers: Nuxt, composable, API请求, Pinia, SSR, 状态管理, 性能优化, 类型安全, 错误处理, 中间件.

ui-beautiful-page
  长页面 / GSAP 叙事流程设计：视觉方向、模块化拆分、运动系统、逐模块验证。当设计 landing page、about page、品牌故事等沉浸式长页面时调用。
  Triggers: beautiful page, landing page, about page, cinematic scroll, 长页面, 叙事动画.

## GSAP Skills

gsap-core
  Core API: gsap.to(), from(), fromTo(), easing, duration, stagger, defaults, transforms, autoAlpha, gsap.matchMedia() (responsive, prefers-reduced-motion).
  Triggers: animation, GSAP, tweens, easing, stagger, transform, opacity, responsive, reduced motion, matchMedia.

gsap-timeline
  Timelines: gsap.timeline(), position parameter, labels, nesting, playback.
  Triggers: sequencing, timeline, keyframes, choreograph, multi-step animation, animation order.

gsap-scrolltrigger
  ScrollTrigger: scroll-linked animations, pinning, scrub, triggers, refresh, cleanup.
  Triggers: scroll animation, parallax, pin section, ScrollTrigger, pin, scrub.

gsap-frameworks
  Vue 3 / Nuxt 4 GSAP 集成：lifecycle, gsap.context() scoping, cleanup on unmount.
  Triggers: Vue, Nuxt, GSAP lifecycle, onMounted, onUnmounted, gsap.context.

gsap-plugins
  项目适用的 GSAP 插件：ScrollToPlugin（动画滚动定位）。
  Triggers: ScrollToPlugin, scroll-to, scrollTo, plugin registration.
